name: Astra
landing_hero_subtitle: Your personal celestial navigation system with telescope control, real-time sky mapping, and automated observation control in one application.
landing_features_subtitle: ASTRA combines intuitive automation with advanced telescope control to make stargazing accessible to everyone.
landing_feature_obs_desc: Experience the night sky in real-time with an advanced simulation engine. Track celestial bodies with pinpoint accuracy.
landing_feature_telescope_desc: Automatically control your telescope manually or with an AI-powered assistant that handles pointing and tracking for you.
landing_feature_ai_desc: Schedule observations, and automate your observation session with our intelligent assistant.
landing_feature_learn_desc: Check an object's information to learn some interesting data or ask our AI-powered assistant to explain complex topics.
landing_feature_global_desc: Connect with your astronomy equipment from anywhere around the world.
landing_feature_night_desc: Experience perfectly calibrated dark themes that preserve your night vision while providing crystal-clear visuals.
landing_tech_card_desc: Accurate celestial tracking powered by data from common catalogs, such as NGC, Messier, etc.
landing_tech_desc_1: ASTRA (Automated Smart Telescope Remote Assistant) represents the next generation of astronomy software. This app bridges the gap between amateur and professional astronomy by simplifying and making astronomy accessible to anyone.
landing_tech_desc_2: Whether you're learning about planets, photographing distant DSOs, or simply exploring the night sky with your telescope, ASTRA adapts to your needs with intelligent automation and precision control.
landing_end_cta_desc: Join thousands of amateur and professional astronomers who use ASTRA to discover the wonders of the universe. Available on the web.
landing_footer_desc: Powering amateur and astronomers worldwide with advanced telescope control, celestial navigation, and automated observation control tools.
